integrity: The claim is supported by a deterministic exhaustive normalized search, direct verification of every normalized equality case, a proof that \(\operatorname{OA}(9,4,3,2)\) implies the perfect-hash property, and exhaustive action of the full stated symmetry group. The verifier is included and uses only the Python standard library.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only at the parameter \(N=4,v=3,t=3\); it gives no general equality theorem. The 2003 thesis source is year-resolved only, so no day is inferred from it. A presently unindexed historical enumeration remains a residual originality risk.
title: All optimal ternary four-row perfect hash families are orthogonal arrays
